contact.physical_semantics: Binary contact indicator — whether the sensor is in physical contact with an object.

contact_centroid.physical_semantics: Center of mass of the contact region, in sensor pixel coordinates or mm.

contact_region.physical_semantics: Coarse-grained contact region on the hand/body surface.

force_magnitude.physical_semantics: Scalar normal contact force magnitude. Most force-sensing sensors can provide this.

force_vector.physical_semantics: 3D contact force vector [Fx, Fy, Fz] in sensor frame. Requires multi-axis force sensing capability.

torque_vector.physical_semantics: 3D torque/moment vector [Mx, My, Mz] at the contact point.

slip_event.physical_semantics: Binary slip detection — whether the object is sliding relative to the sensor.

slip_velocity.physical_semantics: 2D slip velocity vector [vx, vy] in the sensor tangent plane. Contains both direction and magnitude of slip.

manipulation_phase.physical_semantics: Current manipulation phase — the same tactile signal has different meaning at different phases.

texture_class.physical_semantics: Categorical surface texture classification based on tactile exploration.

object_deformation.physical_semantics: Object deformation magnitude in mm or as a ratio. Measures how much the object (or elastomer) deforms under contact.

temperature.physical_semantics: Contact surface temperature. Useful for material identification and thermal property estimation.

confidence.physical_semantics: Annotation confidence/provenance tracking. Essential for data quality assessment.

compliance_level.physical_semantics: Compliance level indicating data information density. L1=Basic, L2=Force-Aware, L3=Full-Vector, L4=Rich-Semantic. Cumulative: L3 implies L2 and L1 compliance.

sensor.description: uSkin 是 XELA Robotics 的分布式触觉传感器，每个 taxel 同时测量 X/Y 剪切与 Z 法向 3 轴力。UniTac-NV 数据集使用 uSPa 46 贴片（4x6=24 taxel，约 100 Hz 录制）。

ft_ground_truth.unit: N (力分量, UniTac-NV 论文标注)

sensor.units_note: UniTac-NV 数据集未文档化 uSkin 力/位移单位；taxel_force / taxel_displacement 为原始读数。Schema 力字段默认 None，提供 force_scale 后按 N 输出。
